name: Nanairo Reincarnation
original_name: なないろリンカネーション
source:
Kagami Makoto is in his 3rd year of college when he inherits the estate of his late grandfather and starts planning out what he's going to do with his newfound home. However, his plans are foiled when his childhood friend Iyo, who turns out to be a zashiki-warashi, introduces herself, looking exactly the same as he remembers her from over a decade ago. Then, a woman named Kikyou, who claims to be a demon, also appears before him. After that, it isn't long before a pretty detective at the police department comes knocking on his door, imploring him to take up his family's duty of helping wandering spirits pass on to the afterlife and assist the police with any and all supernatural crimes reported in town. But when a case that's bigger than any of them ever imagined comes his way, will he be able to handle it? With the power of clairvoyance, an ability passed down through his family that allows him to see spirits, maybe he and his demon familiars can pull through, and he can be a proper successor to his family's legacy.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/751450/Nanairo_Reincarnation/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
加贺美诚正在读大学三年级，他继承了已故祖父的遗产，并开始计划如何处理他的新家。然而，当他儿时的朋友伊予（原来是座敷童子）自我介绍时，他的计划被挫败了，她看起来和他十多年前记忆中的她一模一样。这时，一个自称恶魔、名叫桔梗的女人也出现在他面前。不久之后，警察局的一位漂亮侦探来敲他的门，恳求他承担起家庭的责任，帮助游魂转世，并协助警方处理镇上报告的所有超自然犯罪。但当一个比他们想象的还要大的案子降临到他的面前时，他能处理得了吗？凭借家族传承的千里眼之力，可以看到灵魂的能力，也许他和他的恶魔使魔能够渡过难关，成为家族遗产的合适继承人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/751450/Nanairo_Reincarnation/]Steam[/url]]
